profile.headline: Software Developer at Culligan Quench
profile.summary:
Welcome to my LinkedIn profile! I am a hands-on Integration Architect and Data Engineer with 10+ years of experience designing, developing, and maintaining scalable data pipelines and cross-platform integrations. My focus is on automating business processes and unifying enterprise data across CRM, ERP, financial, and supply chain systems using tools like Boomi, Jitterbit, and native APIs.
I have led end-to-end data migration and integration efforts, including data warehousing, ETL pipeline design, and MDM governance using Profisee. My integration architecture spans Salesforce (Flows, Platform Events), Zuora, and custom-built financial/ERP systems. I have worked extensively with Boomi AtomSphere to build RESTful APIs, schedule-based jobs, and event-driven integrations.
On the infrastructure side, I have managed AWS accounts - including S3, IAM roles, and relational databases and supported virtualized environments using VMware. I am also experienced in reporting technologies (SSRS, Crystal Reports) and Agile delivery using Jira and GitHub.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.locationName: King of Prussia, Pennsylvania, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
problem-solving, process optimization, seamless system integration, automation, ERP integrations, and cloud-based solutions.
Boomi Integration & System Stabilization: Led the Billing Integration Refactor Process in Boomi, enhancing performance and reducing processing errors. Developed technical requirements and supported integrations between external ERP systems, streamlining business operations.
Billing & Payment Automation: Led the integration efforts for Billtrust, automating the movement of bank files and payment application processes to improve financial workflows. Strengthened payment reconciliation and processing, reducing manual intervention and increasing accuracy.
System Stability & Issue Resolution: Stabilizing current integrations and flushing out inconsistencies and bugs. Implemented proactive monitoring and troubleshooting strategies to minimize downtime and operational disruptions.

positions.title: Application analyst
positions.description: Responsible for providing End to End support in Epicor ERP. Including Customization, Crystal Reports, SQL Reports, Dashboard, BAM, BPM, BAQs, Processes, Data Mapping, Module security, Solution deployment. undertake many ERP development projects from start to finish.
